tasks.title: Image Paste Support
tasks.description: Implement clipboard image paste functionality in TipTapEditor. Currently only dialog-based image insertion works. Add paste event handler to detect image data (image/png, image/jpeg), extract blob, call backend image.save, insert Markdown syntax at cursor.
test_criteria: User can paste image from clipboard using Ctrl+V
Pasted image is saved to document directory via backend
Markdown image reference is inserted at cursor position
Image is rendered correctly in editor
tasks.impl_notes: Add paste event handler to TipTapEditor component. Detect image/png and image/jpeg in paste event. Extract blob, call backend image.save command, insert Markdown image syntax at cursor position.

tasks.title: Undo/Redo Keyboard Shortcuts
tasks.description: Wire Ctrl+Z (undo) and Ctrl+Y (redo) keyboard shortcuts to TipTap's built-in undo/redo functionality. Add keyboard event listener to handle these shortcuts without conflicts.
test_criteria: Undo/redo works across all editing operations
tasks.impl_notes: Add keyboard event listener to TipTapEditor. Handle Ctrl+Z for undo and Ctrl+Y for redo. Ensure no conflicts with browser defaults or other handlers.

tasks.title: Recovery UI on Startup
tasks.description: Add startup recovery prompt when crash recovery snapshots exist. Currently snapshots are saved but no UI prompts the user. Create RecoveryModal, check for snapshots on startup, show modal if found.
test_criteria: App checks for snapshots on startup
If snapshots exist, recovery modal is shown
User can choose to recover a snapshot or start fresh
tasks.impl_notes: Create RecoveryModal.jsx component. On app startup, call backend to check for snapshots. If snapshots exist, show RecoveryModal before main editor with list of snapshots and timestamps.

tasks.title: Dirty State Indicator
tasks.description: Add visual indicator when document has unsaved changes. isDirty state already exists but no visual feedback. Add asterisk prefix to title when dirty.
test_criteria: Asterisk (*) appears in title when document is dirty
Indicator visible in both light and dark themes
tasks.impl_notes: Modified Toolbar.jsx to display document title with asterisk prefix when document.isDirty is true. The asterisk uses accent color and is visible in both light and dark themes.

tasks.title: Keyboard Shortcut - New Document (Ctrl+N)
tasks.description: Wire Ctrl+N keyboard shortcut to create new document. Check for dirty state and prompt for save first if needed.
test_criteria: If current document is dirty, prompt for save first
tasks.impl_notes: Add keyboard event handler in App component. Handle Ctrl+N event, check dirty state, prompt if needed, reset to new untitled document.

tasks.title: Keyboard Shortcut - Open File (Ctrl+O)
tasks.description: Wire Ctrl+O keyboard shortcut to open file dialog. Check for dirty state and prompt for save first if needed.
test_criteria: If current document is dirty, prompt for save first
tasks.impl_notes: Add keyboard event handler in App component. Handle Ctrl+O event, check dirty state, call backend open_file command, load file into editor.

tasks.title: Keyboard Shortcut - Open Folder (Ctrl+Shift+O)
tasks.description: Wire Ctrl+Shift+O keyboard shortcut to open workspace folder. Call backend open_folder command and populate sidebar.
tasks.impl_notes: Add keyboard event handler in App component. Handle Ctrl+Shift+O event, call backend open_folder command, update workspace state and sidebar.

tasks.title: Code Syntax Highlighting
tasks.description: Integrate backend syntax highlighting into TipTap code blocks. Backend has highlight_code_block but TipTap doesn't use it. Create CodeBlock extension.
test_criteria: Code blocks render with syntax highlighting
tasks.impl_notes: Create CodeBlock extension for TipTap. Call backend highlight_code_block command, apply HTML highlighting to code block content, support language detection.

tasks.title: Link Editing Behavior
tasks.description: Define and implement consistent link click behavior. Single-click focuses for editing, double-click opens link editor, external links open in browser.
test_criteria: Click on link focuses for editing (not following)
tasks.impl_notes: Define link click behavior spec. Implement single-click to focus for editing, double-click to open edit dialog, handle external links (http://) to open in browser.

tasks.title: Frontmatter Special Rendering
tasks.description: Display frontmatter as collapsible block at document start. Detect frontmatter, render as collapsible section with distinct styling and edit mode.
tasks.impl_notes: Deferred to post-MVP. Detect frontmatter at document start, render as collapsible section, style distinctively, provide edit mode for frontmatter fields.

tasks.title: Table Cell Editing Safety
tasks.description: Implement constrained safe table editing model to prevent table structure corruption. Handle Tab/Enter/Backspace specifically for tables.
test_criteria: Enter does not create new rows incorrectly
Backspace at cell start does not delete row
tasks.impl_notes: Deferred to post-MVP. Create custom table cell behavior, handle Tab/Enter/Backspace specifically for tables, prevent structure corruption.

tasks.title: TipTap Integration Completeness
tasks.description: Not using all TipTap capabilities fully. Many extensions available but not utilized. Review available extensions and implement missing valuable features.
test_criteria: Missing valuable features identified and documented
tasks.impl_notes: Technical Debt - In Progress. Review available TipTap extensions, implement missing valuable features, improve editor capabilities.

tasks.title: Editor State Sync Monitoring
tasks.description: TipTap + Markdown conversion may lose fidelity on round-trip. Establish edge case tests and monitor for reported fidelity issues.
tasks.impl_notes: Technical Debt - Needs Monitoring. Establish edge case tests, monitor for reported fidelity issues, consider alternative approaches post-MVP.

tasks.title: Keyboard Shortcut Centralization
tasks.description: Many keyboard shortcuts not wired. Need centralized shortcut handler. Create centralized keyboard handler, document all shortcuts, implement missing.
tasks.impl_notes: Technical Debt - Needs Work. Create centralized keyboard handler, document all shortcuts, implement missing shortcuts.
